The first beta of CalmList, a calm, keyboard-first task manager. It's now on every platform, all running the same app and syncing with the same account.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Web** | [calmlist-steel.vercel.app/app](https://calmlist-steel.vercel.app/app/) | Nothing to install. Also at [corund207.github.io/CalmList/app](https://corund207.github.io/CalmList/app/). |
| **Windows 10/11** | `CalmList_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe` (recommended) or `CalmList_0.1.0_x64_en-US.msi` | Unsigned: if SmartScreen warns, choose *More info → Run anyway*. |
| **macOS 11+** (Apple Silicon and Intel) | `CalmList_0.1.0_universal.dmg` | Unsigned: the first time, right-click CalmList in Applications → *Open*, or run `xattr -cr /Applications/CalmList.app`. |
| **iOS 16+** | `CalmList_0.1.0-beta.1_iOS-Simulator.zip` | A Simulator build for testing on a Mac with Xcode: unzip it and drag `CalmList.app` onto a running Simulator. An iPhone build via TestFlight will follow. |

## What's in it

- **Smart Quick Add:** dates, times, repeats, priorities, projects and labels are picked out as you type. Also Today, Upcoming, boards, sub-tasks, filters, undo and 48 themes.
- **Free AI:** Ramble (speak or type, get tasks), Task Assist and Filter Assist, running on your device at no cost. You can also use your own Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Grok key.
- **AI assistants:** connect Claude or ChatGPT to your tasks (Settings → Integrations → AI assistants).
- **Google Calendar:** a dedicated *CalmList* calendar for tasks with dates. Connect it from the web app.
- **Sync:** your tasks stay on the device, or sync through Supabase, each account kept private by row-level security. You can export everything, or delete your account, at any time.
- **Privacy:** no analytics, ads or tracking. See [Terms & Privacy](https://calmlist-steel.vercel.app/legal.html).

## Known limitations

- The desktop apps are unsigned, and the iOS build runs only in the Simulator for now.
- In the native apps, Google Calendar is connected from the web app, because Google blocks its sign-in in embedded windows.
- Beta software: export your data now and then (Settings → Data & Privacy → Export JSON).

Found a bug? [Open an issue](https://github.com/corund207/CalmList/issues).
